subject: Timeboxed addendum & rollout plan
messages:
From: Maria Lopez <maria.lopez@edgehealth.com>
To: Evelyn Hart <evelyn.hart@redwood.com>
Cc: contracts@edgehealth.com
Date: Tue, 20 Oct 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Timeboxed addendum request — accelerate Phase 2 + mid-pilot capacity

Evelyn —

Thanks for the walkthrough last week. A quick follow: our product team has confirmed they need an accelerated rollout for Phase 2 and want an interim capacity top-up for the pilot window (approx 30% additional throughput for 6 weeks).

We understand this is a change to the order form and may impact pricing. Can you share a proposed path (change order vs addendum) and estimated delta? Also include any impact to the implementation timeline — we are targeting production by 2027-01-10 and need the capacity to validate load testing before final cutover.

Attaching a short note from our PM with the capacity profile. Happy to jump on a call if helpful.

Thanks,
Maria Lopez
Program Director, EdgeHealth

Attachment: edgehealth_capacity_profile_20261019.csv (attachment stub)

From: Evelyn Hart <evelyn.hart@redwood.com>
To: Maria Lopez <maria.lopez@edgehealth.com>
Cc: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 20 Oct 2026 11:03:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Timeboxed addendum request — accelerate Phase 2 + mid-pilot capacity

Maria —

Appreciate the heads-up. We can do a timeboxed addendum that amends the current order form to add a temporary throughput band for the 6-week window and adjusts the implementation milestones. High level:
- Proposed approach: addendum (short, binding for the six weeks) + temporary Exhibit B w/ throughput band
- Pricing: pro-rated top-up + small surcharge (I’ll include a ballpark in the next message)
- Contract mechanics: we need legal redline on MSA for rollback language and a short statement of work change for dates.

Looping in Jordan for DocuSign/ops and Laura for implementation scheduling. I’ll also pull legal (Karthik) for redlines.

Next steps: Jordan will generate a DocuSign draft, Laura will confirm new milestones, and Karthik will provide redlines to the MSA/order form. If that all looks good to you, we’ll send a redline addendum and a clear acceptance path for your procurement team.

Evelyn Hart
Sr. Account Executive, Redwood Inference

Attachment: EdgeHealth_Addendum_Draft_v1.docx (draft addendum stub)

From: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>
To: Evelyn Hart <evelyn.hart@redwood.com>, Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>
Cc: Maria Lopez <maria.lopez@edgehealth.com>
Date: Wed, 27 Oct 2026 09:30:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Timeboxed addendum request — legal redlines and risk flags

Team / Maria —

I reviewed the proposed addendum draft. High-level comments:
1) Rollback/termination language — the current MSA has a 30-day notice provision; we should not remove the ability to terminate the addendum early if milestones are not met. I’ve added a short fallback clause to retain that protection.
2) Pricing floor — EdgeHealth is requesting a pro-rated top-up; we must preserve the minimum monthly commitment language (Exhibit A). I propose adding a temporary surcharge line item rather than altering the floor.
3) Data handling & logs — the addendum references increased instance counts; operationally we must ensure log retention and KV cache handling align with existing DPA constraints. I flagged a short statement in the redline.
4) Signature block — suggest separate acceptance for the addendum (signed by both parties) rather than modifying the live order form inline. Easier to roll back.

I attached a redlined PDF (redline_msa_kiyer_20261027.pdf) with inline comments. I’ll send an edited addendum that preserves the MSA protections and proposes a surcharge table.

Karthik Iyer
Senior Counsel, Redwood Inference

Attachment: redline_msa_kiyer_20261027.pdf (redline stub)

From: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.com>
To: Evelyn Hart <evelyn.hart@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 28 Oct 2026 08:14:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Timeboxed addendum request — ops / DocuSign draft

Folks —

I generated a DocuSign package with two docs: the addendum (clean) and the redlined MSA as an appendix for review. Link below for Maria once legal signs off.
- DocuSign draft: https://www.docusign.com/edgehealth/addendum/ABC123

Pricing: provisional surcharge = 30% of the token unit rate pro-rated over the 6-week window (to be replaced with final numbers once finance confirms). Laura — can you confirm the milestone dates if we push Phase 2 start by two weeks and insert a hotfix window for load testing? If so I’ll populate the dates and kick to procurement.

Jordan Blake
Revenue Operations, Redwood Inference

Attachment: implementation_timeline_v2.xlsx (timeline stub)

From: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>
To: Maria Lopez <maria.lopez@edgehealth.com>, Evelyn Hart <evelyn.hart@redwood.com>, Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.com>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 28 Oct 2026 16:45:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Timeboxed addendum request — implementation dates confirmed

Maria —

Implementation update: we can accommodate the intermediate capacity increase and shift Phase 2 start by two weeks. Proposed dates:
- Temporary capacity window: 2026-11-15 to 2026-12-27 (6 weeks)
- Load testing hot window: 2026-12-06 to 2026-12-10
- Production cutover target: 2027-01-10 (unchanged)

I also updated the SOW to show the temporary capacity schedule and duties for on-call support during the hot testing window. See attached timeline (implementation_timeline_v2.xlsx). Please confirm procurement acceptance so Jordan can finalize the DocuSign package.

Thanks — happy to sync if EdgeHealth wants a short walkthrough on the support model during the hot window.

Laura Bennett
Director, Implementation Services, Redwood Inference

Attachment: implementation_timeline_v2.xlsx (attachment stub)
